method: Concurrent burst via Python threads + urllib against a locally spawned fixture; curl subprocesses for the sequential control requests and status checks

parameters.note: vulnerable-widened adds an artificial sleep between the check and the write, stated here and in the published post, so a handful of local threads reliably land inside the window. vulnerable-baseline adds no delay; fixed has no check-then-act window to widen.

scope.data: Two synthetic single-use coupon codes held in an in-memory SQLite table

agent_execution.note: HTTP verification was scripted; no model or Excession agent ran
